bio: At Trumfes, you can enjoy traditional Catalan cuisine with a creative touch that is based around seasonal and local ingredients. Choose between the à la carte or the tasting menu, with options enhanced by the occasional and delicious mountain-inspired rice dish as well as game in season. Depending on the time of year, don't miss the creamy black morel mushrooms with green asparagus and brioche, or the veal steak tartare with truffled fried egg and summer truffle....
